angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop bend (Hoop G) vs NFL bend, corner turns and career pressure rate, year-standardized, leave-one-class-out against three no-tracking baselines side by side (pick only, pick + role, full pre-specified) plus a baseline chosen inside each training fold; pass-rush-drill burst tested in the same six-measure family
metric_name: Hoop G: hardest half-second of sideways lean on the Run-the-Hoop figure-eight (speed^2 / turn radius, in g), z within Combine year
headline_number: Held out (n=77): +2.2 pressures per 450 rushes per sd [0.4, 3.8] against the pre-specified full no-tracking forecast; +3.2 / +2.3 / +2.4 against pick only / pick + role / fold-chosen baseline, every slope interval above zero and every R2 gain interval spanning zero (pick + role: 0.06 [-0.10, 0.20]); best-of-six p = 0.10. verify.py on the identical 77 rushers: 2.2 [0.3, 3.8]. Simulation: one lap shows ~65% of a true slope; true slopes 1.1 to 5.9 fit.
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round 22 revised (8.42). DS: one rusher set and one fill rule (training-fold median) in both analysis.py and verify.py, which now rebuilds the same 77 from raw frames (exact set match, 2.2 vs 2.2); three baselines side by side plus a nested fold-chosen baseline and 200 random splits; measurement-error simulation replaces the disattenuated 4.1 [0.4, 11.2] (implied true slope 3.4, range 1.1-5.9; power 87% one lap vs 97% four laps); EPA-per-pressure source traced (time_to_pressure / sack on 1,655 random DL plays; pressure_allowed is a blocker column, 100% empty for DL); rush counts defined (median 17 two-second rushes for 85 linemen; 20 before the filter across 86). Football: film check via corner-turn rate (top third Hoop G 29% vs bottom 21%, gap 9 [3, 15]; corner-turn rushes pressured 15% vs 7%); why NFL turns are 2.7x wider; Monday scout / coach / Combine lines; film list in Hoop G order, split into open-first and missed, with honest hit rate (Hoop G top third beat forecast 47% = rest 47%; top-third gap vs pick 7 [-13, 40] < 20 bar); coaching reads now computed (fixed two wrong round-22 reads: Harrell is not the most-used, Ingram-Dawkins not Watts has the slowest get-off); frozen 2026 rule promoted to its own section. Writeup: two-sentence plain lede, three robustness bullets, multiplicity / independent script / variants in appendix, jargon (Turn Match, errors-in-variables, disattenuate) removed. Viz: Fig 1 one panel per man with a third null-case man, turn circles, scale bars and a shared colorbar; Fig 2 adds the simulation panel, labelled NFL ticks and legend entries; Fig 3 one highlight colour, labelled chance line, 13-pt p columns; Fig 4 player-card grid (hoop lap + NFL fan + result) sorted by Hoop G with grey intervals that overlap the margin.
open_risks: Headline slope moved from 1.8 to 2.2 because the main fill rule changed to the training-fold median; a judge may read this as a forking path even though it was requested for reconciliation (regression fill reported: 1.8)
Best-of-six p is 0.10 and all R2 gain intervals span zero; the full pre-specified baseline overfits (held-out R2 -0.04), which flatters the gain against it
Corner-turn film check is co-occurrence: beating the tackle may cause both the turn and the pressure; no blockers in the data
Film list day-3 hit rate shows no gain over pick order or the forecast alone; the case for using Hoop G at all rests on the slope and the frozen 2026 test
Main text plus appendix is 1,904 words, above the ~1,450 the writeup judge suggested
Coaching reads are hand-written (facts computed) from 16-19 sampled rushes each
